parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Discord channel by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-discord` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Discord channel — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional Discord channels bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_url_plus: ${ customer_secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_BASE ?? https://discord.com/api/webhooks }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_token_secret }} }

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Discord webhook id

webhook_token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Discord webhook token
